// Historical GET image alias remains shared by Bot rendering; generation has retired.
export { GET } from './images/route'

import { desktopConfig } from '@/lib/desktop-rpc/bootstrap'
import { withRequestLog } from '@/lib/request-log'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const GET = withRequestLog('/api/desktop/config', async () =>
  Response.json(await desktopConfig(), { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } }))

import { githubAppManifestRoutes } from '@/lib/github/manifest-runtime'
import { freshSessionRoute } from '@/lib/fresh-session'
import { withRequestLog } from '@/lib/request-log'

export const GET = freshSessionRoute(withRequestLog('/api/github/manifest/callback', githubAppManifestRoutes.callback))

import { decisionsHttp } from '@/lib/project-map/http'
export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export async function POST(request: Request, context: { params: Promise<{ projectId: string }> }) { return decisionsHttp(request, (await context.params).projectId, true) }

import { serverInfoResponse } from '@/lib/server-info'
import { withRequestLog } from '@/lib/request-log'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const GET = withRequestLog('/api/server', (request: Request) => serverInfoResponse(request))

import { subscriptionCallback } from '@/lib/subscription-http'
import { subscriptionHTTPDependencies } from '@/lib/subscription-http-runtime'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const maxDuration = 60
export const GET = (request: Request) => subscriptionCallback(request, subscriptionHTTPDependencies)

import { subscriptionUsage } from '@/lib/subscription-http'
import { subscriptionHTTPDependencies } from '@/lib/subscription-http-runtime'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'
export const maxDuration = 30
export const GET = (request: Request) => subscriptionUsage(request, subscriptionHTTPDependencies)

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { withRequestLog } from '@/lib/request-log'

import { APP_BUILD, minDesktopVersion } from '@/lib/app-build'
import { MIN_MOBILE_BUILD, MOBILE_UPDATE_URL } from '@/lib/mobile-min-build'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

/**
 * The build this deployment serves, so an open page can tell it is out of
 * date; for the iOS app's launch, the oldest native build it accepts and
 * where to get a newer one; and the oldest desktop app it still serves
 * (MIN_CLIENT_VERSION). Read before sign-in, so it needs no session.
 */
export const GET = withRequestLog('/api/version', () => {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { build: APP_BUILD, overlaySha: process.env.MIKKA_UI_OVERLAY_SHA || null, minMobileBuild: MIN_MOBILE_BUILD, mobileUpdateUrl: MOBILE_UPDATE_URL, minDesktopVersion: minDesktopVersion(process.env.MIN_CLIENT_VERSION) },
    { headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store, max-age=0' } },
  )
})
